$$\mu
=
2K'+\frac{S-U}{2}

D'
&=2(N-1-K')
-\sum_{\substack{Q\text{ shifted}\\Q\cap P=\varnothing}}t_Q\\
&=2(N-1)-\mu+\frac{S-U}{2}.
\end{aligned}$$
The physical table gives
$$D=2N-\mu+\frac{U-S}{2}.$$
Subtracting,
$$\begin{aligned}
D-D'
&=2+\frac{U-S}{2}-\frac{S-U}{2}\\
&=2+U-S.
\end{aligned}$$
Therefore
$$\boxed{D=2-S+U+D'.}$$
Likewise,
$$\begin{aligned}
A-D'
&=
\left(2(N-1)+\frac{S+U}{2}-\mu\right)
-\left(2(N-1)-\mu+\frac{S-U}{2}\right)\\
&=U,
\end{aligned}$$
hence
$$\boxed{A=U+D'.}$$
Every shifted no- $P$  square contains at most two selected vertices. Thus  $D'$  is a nonnegative integer, and
$$D\ge2-S+U.$$
